# Skanskas orderingång högre än väntat – Yubico dubblar vinsten

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-05  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This EFN Morgon episode covers the Q3 reports. Yubico (operating profit roughly doubled, though it set softer financial targets), Camurus, Apotea and Skanska (record order intake) were the strong ones; Matas was weak and Dormy reported falling October sales. China has blocked ABB's planned sale of its Robotics unit to SoftBank, but the hosts think the share price hit will be limited. The market mood is upbeat after a relief rally following the US midterm elections. The hosts see the rally spreading to small caps and consumer stocks, with continued doubt about data-center stocks. They rate H&M as wait-and-see.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 YUBICO — Yubico | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Report far above estimates: margin 25% vs ~14% expected, revenue +29%. Host expects the shares to do very well.

#### Reasoning

Host Ture says the report is very strong and far above estimates: margin nearly double what the market expected, and revenue growth well ahead. The shares had dipped in the past week, which supports a bounce. The softer long-term targets are a caveat, but the CEO argues they cover a five-year period.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth slows toward the softer long-term targets
- if margin falls back from 25%

> *"Så jag tror att den här kommer gå riktigt bra, även om det redan har gått väldigt bra"*

---

### 🟢 CAMX — Camurus | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Operating profit +40% to 322m, above expectations; strong growth in Buvidal/Brixadi.

#### Reasoning

Hosts call it a strong report: 28% organic growth, an improving margin, and results above consensus. They expect the shares to jump, and the stock opened up ~8%.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth of the opioid treatments slows
- if regulatory setbacks hit the obesity program

> *"Och var väl en bit över förväntningarna så den här tror jag kan sticka."*

---

### 🟢 APOTEA — Apotea | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

EBIT margin 5.4%, above its medium-term target; the Varberg logistics centre is paying off; the long-term target is 7-8%.

#### Reasoning

Host says Apotea has left its 3-5% margin range, now has a platform to grow fast for a long time, and can push the margin toward the 7-8% long-term target. Its competitor Meds has logistics problems.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the margin falls back below 5%
- if Kicks/Matas competition in pharmacy-like products hurts growth

> *"Så det ser ut som att de kan ha en fin resa framåt om de jobbar sig upp mot det."*

---

### 🟢 SKA-B — Skanska | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Record order intake and backlog; construction margin 5% vs a 4% target; US profitability should rise as the backlog converts.

#### Reasoning

Host chooses optimism despite data-center doubts: the margin is well above target, the US is even more profitable, and margins could rise further as the backlog converts. The CEO says data-center contracts are binding and financed. The muted price reaction and US property writedowns are caveats.

#### Sell Triggers

- if data-center projects get cancelled
- if US property writedowns grow
- if the construction margin falls below 4%

> *"Så jag tycker den ser stark ut."*

---

### 🟡 HM-B — H&M | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Low growth and P/E ~20 make the shares hard to like, but the ~4% dividend yield and Persson buyout option support them.

#### Reasoning

Host Ture: the margin is just under 9% and analysts expect it to stay there, growth is near zero, and P/E is just over 20, so the shares are hard to like. A sell call is also hard to make given the ~4% yield and the family's growing stake (75%). Verdict: wait-and-see.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the dividend is cut
- if the margin falls from ~9%
- if the Persson family stops buying shares

> *"Och då landar åtminstone jag i att just nu så är det en avvaktare på den här aktien."*

---

### ⛔ DORMY — Dormy | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

October sales -10%; summer sales were weak; the hosts advised not to subscribe at the IPO; shares below the 70 SEK listing price.

#### Reasoning

Hosts recommended not subscribing at the IPO and still note weakening sales: October -10% following a weak summer. They call it a nice company with an impressive journey but did not want to buy in.

> *"Det är ett fint bolag som har gjort en jätteimponerande resa men vi tyckte inte att man skulle... slår till på den"*

---

### 🟡 ABB — ABB | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Robotics sale blocked by China, but the hit is ~3% of market cap. Hosts say the shares should not fall much; the deal may still go through or an IPO is possible.

#### Reasoning

Hosts see the Robotics deal blockage as a setback that limits M&A and buybacks (Citi: 10bn→5bn), but say it is not a big deal relative to the ~1,500bn SEK market cap. The deal could still be restructured, the unit sold to someone else, or listed in Stockholm. ABB already fell 12% in October.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Robotics deal is abandoned at a much lower valuation
- if data-center expectations weaken further

> *"Jag tycker inte de ska falla så himla mycket på det här egentligen."*

---
